prompt: mattpocock 的 skills 仓库里有个 skill 叫 grill-me，帮我装到 my-skills 里，用软链。先检查是不是已经装过了，再给安装方案。

assertions.name: detect-already-installed
assertions.description: 查重识别 grill-me 已装
assertions.text: 输出应识别出 grill-me 已在 my-skills 中安装

assertions.name: handle-duplicate
assertions.text: 输出应告知用户重复并跳过或提示

assertions.name: symlink-installation
assertions.description: 按用户指定软链方式给安装方案
assertions.text: 输出应包含软链(ln -s/link-skills.sh)安装方案
